alarms.action_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for alarm actions to complete.

alarms.history.enabled.description: Persist alarm state transitions to the database.

api.bind_host.description: IP address on which the Aodh API server listens for requests. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces or a specific IP for security.

api.bind_port.description: Port number for the Aodh API service.

api.ssl.cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (used only if SSL is enabled).

api.ssl.enabled.description: Whether to enable built-in SSL/TLS (not recommended; prefer proxy termination).

api.ssl.key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (used only if SSL is enabled).

api.workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle requests. Increase on multi-core systems for higher throughput.

auth.strategy.description: Authentication strategy. Use 'keystone' in production; 'noauth' only for development/testing.

cors.allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing). Leave empty to disable CORS. Use ['*'] for development only.

database.connection.description: Database connection URL (SQLite for dev, PostgreSQL/MySQL for production).

database.connection_retries.description: Number of retry attempts for database connection failures.

database.max_overflow.description: Maximum number of connections above pool_size that may be opened in bursts.

database.pool_size.description: Base number of database connections in the pool.

evaluation.enabled.description: Enable evaluation of alarms (requires Aodh evaluator service to be running).

events.sources.description: List of event source definitions for event-based alarms.

connection.description: Optional connection string (e.g., URL for HTTP source).

name.description: Unique identifier for this event source.

healthcheck.uri.description: Path for HTTP health check endpoint used by load balancers.

keystone.auth_url.description: Override Keystone auth URL if needed (e.g., for multi-region setups or special DNS).

keystone.endpoint_type.description: Keystone endpoint type to use: 'public', 'internal', or 'admin'.

keystone.password.description: Service user password. Use secrets management in production.

keystone.project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain for the service project.

keystone.project_name.description: Service project (tenant) name for Keystone authentication.

keystone.region_name.description: OpenStack region name where this Aodh API instance operates.

keystone.user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain for the service user (required in Keystone v3).

keystone.username.description: Service user account name for Keystone auth.

legacy.ceilometer_compat.description: Enable legacy Ceilometer compatibility mode. Only for migrations from older Ceilometer deployments.

messaging.transport_url.description: Connection URL to the message broker (e.g., RabbitMQ or Redis). Required for coordination with Aodh evaluator.

metrics.backend.description: Backend for alarm history/metrics storage (e.g., 'influxdb', 'mongodb', 'gnocchi'). Leave blank to use the main database.

metrics.gnocchi.auth_url.description: Keystone auth URL for Gnocchi service (used if backend = gnocchi).

metrics.gnocchi.password.description: Gnocchi service password (used if backend = gnocchi).

metrics.gnocchi.project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain for Gnocchi project (used if backend = gnocchi).

metrics.gnocchi.project_name.description: Project name for Gnocchi service auth (used if backend = gnocchi).

metrics.gnocchi.user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain for Gnocchi user (used if backend = gnocchi).

metrics.gnocchi.username.description: Gnocchi service username (used if backend = gnocchi).

metrics.influxdb.dbname.description: InfluxDB database name (used if backend = influxdb).

metrics.mongodb.dbname.description: MongoDB database name (used if backend = mongodb).

metrics.mongodb.url.description: MongoDB connection URL (used if backend = mongodb).

notifications.default_method.description: Default notification method when no method is specified in an alarm definition.

notifications.drivers.description: List of notification driver configurations to enable (e.g., for email or webhook integration).

config.description: Optional JSON configuration string for the driver (e.g., {'to': ['admin@example.com']} for mailto).

rate_limit.enabled.description: Enable per-IP request rate limiting to prevent abuse.

rate_limit.requests.description: Maximum requests allowed per window before throttling.

rate_limit.window.description: Rate limiting window duration in seconds.
